title: Ep 45: Starship Flight 13's intact upper-stage splashdown moves the program one step closer to attempting the first tower catch of the Ship on Flight 14.

Ep 44: Starship Flight 13's V3 Starlink deployment and intact splashdown clears the path for a tower-catch attempt on the next flight.
Ep 551: Tesla is sending AI safety operators into Colombia and Chile to oversee the first Robotaxi operations outside North America.
Ep 39: Vandenberg’s 50th launch of 2026 shows Falcon 9 reuse sustaining cadence while Starship readies its next V3 test flight.
Ep 549: NHTSA's engineering analysis of FSD on 3.2 million vehicles puts Tesla's camera-only system under final scrutiny before any recall decision.
